description: R0-35-EXIT-PROOF binds R0-05-ID-REALDB-TENANT-ALIGN's suites: the identity guard-chain real-DB suite (identity-boundary.integration.test.ts, created as R0-AB-04-IDENTITY-BOUNDARY-PROOF at e35231c3 and extended by the R0-ID-F1..F7 identity chain, R0-09 and its D-11 follow-ups), the TenantInterceptor alignment (tenant.interceptor.spec.ts and tenant-interceptor-alignment.integration.test.ts, created by R0-F24-TENANT-INTERCEPTOR-ALIGN at febe5f08), and tenant-membership-boundary.integration.test.ts (the queue's tests_first). The queue planned this manifest under this name; it was never added, so R0-35 adds it. Every case that passed at the R0-35 head is required (172 cases); allowAdditionalCases is true so a later packet may add a case without editing this manifest, while a required case that is renamed, skipped, turned into a todo or deleted rejects the verdict, and a new skip or todo fails release0-proof-coverage.spec.ts until scripts/proof-admission/release0-index.json explains it. Run from the repo root: node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only identity-boundary.json (or pnpm --filter server proof:release0 for every Release 0 manifest), against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL.
